info.title: Bernouy Hub API
info.description: Tenant orchestration API. Authenticate with a Keycloak service-account JWT in the configured api-auth realm.

url.description: Base URL of the data-provider (no trailing slash).

tenantId.description: Optional explicit id; generated from the providerId when omitted.

issuers.description: Trusted issuers granted tenant-role on this DP. May be empty (issuers can be attached later). Each iss is globally unique across tenants.
Trusted issuers granted tenant-role on this DP. May be empty (issuers can be attached later). Each iss is globally unique across tenants.

get.description: Returns the hub's iss URL, JWKS URL, metadoc URL, and a ready-to-copy allowlist entry the operator pastes into each DP's config before importing it.

delete.description: Removes the DP from the hub's meta-registry. Does NOT touch the DP's own tenants — their data stays intact on the DP. To clean up tenants on the DP, call DELETE /api/tenants/providers BEFORE this.

get.description: Without `?providerId=`: returns the list (summaries — no schemas). With `?providerId=X`: returns the full row including the 4 cached schemas.

schema.description: If set, returns the single DP with that id (incl. cached schemas); otherwise returns the list.

parameters.description: If set, returns the single DP with that id (incl. cached schemas); otherwise returns the list.
parameters.name: providerId

post.description: Fetches the DP's 4 discovery documents (/.well-known/data-provider-info, /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, JWKS, /openapi.admin.json, opt. /openapi.tenant-config.json), validates them, and stores the result in the hub's meta-registry. The DP MUST already trust the hub's iss as control-plane.

get.description: Proxies the DP's control-plane GET /admin/logs. Filters kind/level/time, bounded pagination via cursor.

post.description: Re-fetches the 4 discovery documents and updates the cache. Call after a version bump on the DP.

delete.description: Deactivates the namespace on every DP it has a provision on (best-effort), then drops the namespace + provisions rows. Operator must accept the destructive side-effects on data-providers.

post.description: Pure metadata — the hub does NOT create Keycloak realms, OIDC clients, or users. A namespace is just a logical grouping of (DP × tenant) provisions.

patch.description: Patches displayName and/or description. namespaceId itself is immutable (it's also used as tenantId on every DP).

get.description: Without `namespaceId`: returns the list. With `?namespaceId=X`: returns one or 404.

schema.description: If set, returns the single namespace or 404.

parameters.description: If set, returns the single namespace or 404.
parameters.name: namespaceId

get.summary: Read a namespace's logs (all its tenants)
get.description: Aggregates logs across every tenant of the namespace (possibly on different DPs), merged + sorted by ts desc, truncated to `limit`. No cursor (heterogeneous sources).
`?namespaceId=X`: tenants in a namespace. `?providerId=X`: tenants for a DP. `?tenantId=X`: a single tenant (200 + null when absent).

post.summary: Add a tenant to a namespace for a DP
post.description: Mints a hub CP token, POSTs /admin/tenants on the DP with a fresh `tenantId` + issuers + optional `providerConfig`, then mirrors the row. A namespace may hold multiple tenants of the same DP.

patch.description: PATCHes `issuers`, `providerConfig`, and/or `status` on the DP, mirrors in the hub. `displayName` is hub-local only.

schema.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.

parameters.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.
parameters.name: tenantId

delete.description: DELETE /admin/tenants on the DP, then drop the local row. `?force=true` overrides the DP's grace policy (base.md §8).

schema.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.

parameters.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.
parameters.name: tenantId

get.description: Resolves the tenant's DP, then proxies GET /admin/logs scoped to that tenant. Filters kind/level/time, bounded pagination via cursor.
Resolves the tenant's DP and proxies GET /admin/info — read-only facts the provider surfaces (e.g. a realm issuer URL). Distinct from the editable §11 config.

get.summary: Read the live config from the DP for a tenant
get.description: GETs /admin/config on the DP. Returns 200 with `data: null` when nothing is stored yet (so the UI doesn't see a 404 in DevTools).

schema.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.

parameters.description: Globally-unique tenant id (lowercase + digits + dash, ≤63 chars). Sent to the DP as `tenantId`.
parameters.name: tenantId

get.description: Returns 200 if the hub process is up. Does NOT cross the network to any data-provider.
